newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares drop after May prices data.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares drop after May prices data.

text.p: 1428 GMT - Portuguese shares extended losses after disappointing May inflation data and dealers expected share prices to edge lower throughout the remainder of the session. "There was a generalised correction in share prices, except for EDP which soared after its privatisation. The overall correction was accentuated by the May CPI data," one operator said. "The rise in inflation rules out for now any cut in official rates, and the market is never glad to hear such news," he added.
